A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have derived analytical expressions for the ergodic capacity of multiple-input multiple-out MIMO keyhole channels with partial CSI at the transmitter (CSIT) and perfect CSI at the receiver (CSIR).
we derive exact analytical expressions for ergodic capacity and outage probability of MIMO keyhole channels with arbitrary antenna selection at the transmitter or the receiver side.

we have shown that the ergodic capacity of the considered MIMO keyhole channels is always upper bounded by the ergodic capacity obtained in the case of perfect CSI at the receiver and the transmitter, and that the ergodic capacities obtained for partial and no CSI at the transmitter are always upper and lower bounded by the ergodc capacity obtained for perfect CSI at the transmitter and the receiver.
